title: Outlook mobile: Purview DLP policy tips for iOS and Android (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the briefing turns a desktop Outlook licensing requirement into a mandatory licence check for Outlook mobile without documentation establishing that requirement. The roadmap facts, default and control routes are supported, but Microsoft pages also disagree about mobile support and supported conditions.
